dct_title_s: Landslide and flash floods impact analysis West of Durban, eThekwini Metropolitan Municipality, KwaZulu-Natal Provincce,
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20220418ZAF** This map illustrates satellite-detected landslides/mudflow West of Durban City, eThekwini Metropolitan Municipality, KwaZulu-Natal Province, South Africa as observed from a WorldView-3 imagery acquired on 14 April 2022. Within the analyzed area, at least 62 structures and 2 bridges appear to be affected by floods and/or landslides. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
